easyPrerequisites: Bazaar Trader does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Bazaar Trader by tapping it, causing target opponent to gain control of Surrak.
Cast Orcish Bowmasters by paying {1}{B}.
When Orcish Bowmasters enters, it triggers, targeting Surrak.
Surrak triggers, causing the opponent that controls it to draw a card.
Orcish Bowmasters triggers, targeting Surrak.
Repeat from step 4 until the opponent loses the game due to drawing from an empty library.
